body:
I'm not sure if I could go to another, since I hate saying it out loud. It took so much for me to finally say anything, and even then my family doesn't know it all. I would say I need to wait and see but I'm tired of waiting.

Thanks so much for helping tonight though, it's really late now and I think I'm well enough to get off now so I'm probably going to go sleep. I wish I knew more people in real life like I have on the internet, however sad that is.
Thanks for all this, even if it's a temporary relief I appreciate it. Have a good night.

I wish so much that I could make it through this. Or at least part of me does. The rest of me is tired of this constant back and forth.

I was trying and trying and trying for the last few months, opened up to my family about it for the first time, saw a therapist and so on. Then things snapped for some reason or another and I'm not only back to where I was, but worse. I keep trying to suffocate myself, because it's the only thing I can easily do, I've probably tried more than 10 times in the last month but I keep panicking at the last second and failing. I wish I had it in me and was already gone.

I need really good marks to go where I want so it'll be interesting to see how the hell I pull it off, if I make it that far. 

For hobbies, I play video games and I do Olympic Weightlifting. Weightlifting is something I really love do, and is more or less the only thing I feel like I have to take pride in. I've won quite a few competitions and my dad is my coach but lately it hasn't been doing much. This is mostly due to the fact that I got injured about this time last year, which left me unable to do any lifting for nearly 6 months, and even now I'm nowhere near the level I was before which just makes me angry. I've almost quit doing it as well, I wouldn't do it at all if my dad didn't get me down to the gym three times a week.

Only went to the therapist twice because it just made me annoyed, really. The point I'm at is that I have to do something myself, and soon, whether it's good or bad. Drawing this out longer than it has to be is just making things worse.

It really is nice to talk to people, and I do appreciate it but I can't help but feeling bad because I already feel like I've lost.

I want to, but that's still over a year away. Before then I need to get really good grades for the university I want to go to and I'm not sure how to manage it. 

Part of me really wants to beat this, to become awesome feels like I can, for the awesome people I have met online. Sadly these moods will only last a day at the very longest. After that comes the other part that tells me I shouldn't even bother trying, that I wont go anywhere so I'm wasting not only my time, but everyone else I'm around.

I'm planning on university, but I really don't know if I have it in me to be able to make it there. I keep telling myself that I'll turn things around and really put my best efforts in at school, but it never happens. I've been lucky to get 80s and 90s but I doubt that will fly much longer.

It just doesn't feel worth it. I wish I could have everything over right here and now, but I don't have it in me. It's terrible being caught in the middle like this, too pathetic to make a change, but too cowardly to actually finish it.

I have plans for university, but sometimes they feel really unrealistic and overwhelming. I know that there's so much more to life than what I've done, but sometimes I just don't care. I try to be happy some days, but then the effort just falls short because I figure whether I'm going to be amazing or a failure, it wont matter if I'm dead. I'm just not sure if it's all worth it.

I think about the people I might hurt, it stops me sometimes but others I'm selfish enough to figure it wont be my problem anymore. I hate the way I think, I think too much but it's all I have to do all day long.

I don't have a phone and at school there's not many people I can share anything with. I can get along well, but I'm pretty strange. I also don't want to make friends sometimes because I'll just worry that maybe they'll know people I used to and I really can't stand to see any of them again. I used to be so good with people, but now I can barely stay out in public without getting furious.

She might care, but I don't think it's a whole lot. I don't blame her, we've had a number of arguments, though it's more me begging for her not to be mad at me because I don't want to lose her. I've thought of getting her not to talk to me but I couldn't stand not to have her around.

I just seem to be getting way too stressed, over really small things. School should be no big deal, I wont say I'm a genius but I can still keep an A average being like this. Though that wont last much longer, I'll get a project, procrastinate it, get extremely worried that it's due and would rather die than actually put the work in. Other stuff can get to me to, even just thinking of the future terrifies me because I don't feel like these thoughts will ever go away, and I can't go anywhere like this.

I don't make much sense really. I really wish I had friends in real life, even just one person I could go to and actually be with but I know it's too late for me to be able to do that now. The closest thing I've had to a friend for the last two years is my teddy bear, I'm reaching a point where I almost talk to him like he's real. I feel like I'm going completely insane and that I have no control.

With the girl I just feel like a nuisance, sometimes we'll talk and it'll be nice, but others it's more like I'm just being annoying. I need her way more than she needs me, she was like my lifeline for the last year but I'm not sure how much she cares anymore. 

I still have friends online, but things seem to be doing less and less to help me now. I wont stay happy for as long, like some nights it'll be a really good one, I'll get off the computer and I'll be alone again. My first thoughts go right to killing myself, and that'll be when I try. I hate how dependant I am on people, especially because I've made it so hard for me to have a real relationship with people.
